Based on 253 reviews

Reviewers largely see PostHog as a developer-friendly all-in-one platform that replaces several separate tools for analytics, session replay, feature flags, funnels, and experiments. They repeatedly praise fast setup, flexible event tracking, self-hosting, open-source transparency, and clear dashboards that help teams spot drop-off, bugs, and UX issues quickly. Founders of Roundtable, VC Boom, and Upstream describe using it to monitor adoption, funnels, and edge cases. Main drawbacks: some UI/navigation rough edges, privacy controls in replay, and a learning curve for less technical teams.
